turns.question: What was the median order amount in EUR for non-cancelled orders placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median order value metric, so I cannot give the median; the closest metric, average order value (EUR), was 114.39 EUR over non-cancelled orders placed 1 to 30 September 2026, averaged over the whole period.
